hero.eyebrow: For Women Ready to Come Home
hero.subtitle: You've become the keeper of everyone else's life — the calendar, the laundry, the emotional weight of the whole house. But somewhere along the way, you forgot her. The wild, soft, sacred soul who once lit up every room she walked into. She's still there. Waiting.

marquee: A Sacred Space for Deep Transformation

seeking.heading: You Are Seeking a Way Back to Yourself
seeking.intro: Sometimes, the advice everyone gives — "just love yourself," "take more me-time" — doesn't quiet the ache in your soul. Countless women stay stuck, believing they have to try harder. When the truth is, they need to be
seeking.italicQuote: Remember being a girl, when you danced for no reason, laughed from your belly, and knew exactly who you were?
seeking.outro: That wasn't a fairy tale. That was before you started carrying a weight that was never yours to hold.

natureStrip1.alt: Delicate white flowers — quiet beauty waiting to bloom

problems.heading: What Is Keeping You from the Woman You Know You Are?

items.title: You're Not Struggling. You're Contained.
items.desc: There's a version of you that's been waiting — patient, powerful, restless — for you to stop playing the game you outgrew years ago. You can feel her. You just can't seem to get to her.

items.title: You Pull Back Every Time It Gets Real
items.desc: The capability is real. The goal is clear. But the moment you're about to step fully into it — something pulls you back. Every. Single. Time. And you're running out of explanations for why.

items.title: Highly Capable. Completely Overwhelmed.
items.desc: You can manage anything except the noise inside your own head. You don't need another strategy. You need the chaos to stop — so you can finally hear yourself think, decide, and move.

items.title: The Most Powerful Person — Who Never Goes First
items.desc: You've spent years making yourself smaller so others could feel bigger. You're the most capable, most restrained person in every room. And it's costing you everything.

items.title: Excellent at Doing. Starving to Feel Alive.
items.desc: You've mastered showing up, producing, delivering. But somewhere in all that excellence, the feeling vanished. You want more than performance. You want to be lit up by your own life again.

items.title: You've Tasted Freedom — Then Talked Yourself Out of It
items.desc: That version of you — unguarded, certain, electric, completely free. You've felt her. She's not a fantasy. She's not who you used to be. She's who you actually are. Buried. Ready. Done waiting.

sacredSignal.quote: If you're experiencing any of these, it's not a sign you are broken. It's a sacred signal that you are ready to come home.
sacredSignal.outro: You need a space where you can stop managing your pain and finally release it. True, lasting transformation is not an intellectual process — it is an embodied return.

homecoming.heading: Homecoming: Your Path Back to You

steps.title: A Moment of Truth
steps.desc: We begin with a sacred conversation — not a sales call. A moment carved out of your life, for your life. Where you can finally tell the truth without fear, without judgment, without having to manage anyone else's reaction.

steps.title: The Sacred Release
steps.desc: In our private sessions, Cindy creates an impeccable container of safety. You do not have to relive your trauma to heal from it. You just have to be willing to let it move through you — and let it go.

steps.title: Your Embodied Return
steps.desc: This is where you feel the shift in your bones. You walk away lighter, calmer, with a renewed sense of who you are. Not performing. Not managing. Actually living — in a life that finally feels like yours.

finalCta.subtitle: You weren't made to disappear in the margins of your own life. A conversation is the first step to finding your way back. This is not another obligation. It's a sacred moment carved out just for you.
